posts.title: Welfare of dogs and cats and their traceability
posts.label: 📜 Published in the Official Journal
posts.summary: Rules require dog and cat owners to register their pets and keep records of their identification. The law sets welfare standards to protect the health and wellbeing of dogs and cats.
posts.whatsNext: It's law. It enters into force on the date it specifies or, if none, the 20th day after publication in the Official Journal.

posts.title: European Public Prosecutor’s Office (EPPO) and European Anti-Fraud Office (OLAF): access to value added tax information at Union level
posts.label: 📜 Published in the Official Journal
posts.summary: This law allows two European agencies that fight fraud and financial crime to access value added tax records across the EU so they can investigate cases more effectively.
posts.whatsNext: It's law. It enters into force on the date it specifies or, if none, the 20th day after publication in the Official Journal.
